text: The purpose of this report is to seek approval from the Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) Board of Directors to award a single retainer contract to Smith and Andersen Consulting Engineering, in an amount up to $1,500,000, excluding Harmonized Sales Tax (HST), for consulting engineering services to support infrastructure modernization, customer experience improvements, and electrification upgrades across Toronto Parking Authority’s surface parking portfolio. The proposed contract will support a coordinated, multi-site program of improvements intended to modernize Toronto Parking Authority’s surface parking facilities, enable future electrification initiatives, including Bike Share Toronto electrification where applicable, and improve the safety, functionality, reliability, and customer experience of these locations.
